name: python-frontend
body: A first-class Python frontend: language id `py`, artifact `pyfrontend`, a standalone Rust binary built on Astral's `ty` type-checker engine with Ruff parser crates vendored as git deps pinned to the ruff repo tag — the same vendored-pin pattern as src/rustlib's rust-analyzer pin, bumped atomically (requirements.constraint.python-ty-ruff-pin-policy) — so a scan needs no Python runtime. It accepts .py/.pyi sources, resolves calls/uses through `ty`'s project semantics, emits an UnresolvedTarget (with a category) for anything `ty` cannot resolve, and fits the incremental frontend contract (full-context resolution, targeted emission, native cache). The project environment — a uv project, a virtualenv, or a bare src root — is auto-detected and supplied to `ty`'s project context so third-party imports resolve against the real environment (requirements.note.python-frontend-open-points #3 DECIDED); the environment tree stays a discovery exclusion and is available only as a resolution input. Feature python-frontend. Decomposes into accepted extensions, the __init__.py package/module identity model, ty-based resolution, unresolved categories, language plumbing, code-type classification, build/integration, the incremental contract, and acceptance fixtures.
